description: Check a rights manifest's signature against Rightshold's issuer keys and confirm its hash was recorded on the ledger; with deliverable_sha256, also that it covers those exact bytes. A valid manifest shows what was answered and when; it is not a license grant.

deliverable_sha256.description: Optional: the SHA-256 of the deliverable you received

name: verify_rights_manifest
title: Verify a rights manifest
